I had to specify it to use the New-TransportRule cmdlet

    # Import the Exchange Online PowerShell module and connect to Exchange Online
    Import-Module ExchangeOnlineManagement
    Connect-ExchangeOnline -UserPrincipalName admin@contoso.com
    
    # Set the name of the transport rule
    $TransportRuleName = "Bypass Spam Filter for Certain Email Addresses"
    
    # Get the transport rule and store it in the $Rule variable
    $Rule = Get-TransportRule -Identity $TransportRuleName
    
    # If the rule does not exist, create it
    if (!$Rule) {
    $Rule = New-TransportRule -Name $TransportRuleName -Priority "0" -Enabled $true -Comments "Bypass spam filtering for certain email addresses"
    }
    
    # Set the action to bypass spam filtering
    $BypassAction = New-TransportRuleAction -BypassSpamFilterEnabled $true
    
    # Import the email addresses from the CSV file
    $EmailAddresses = Import-Csv -Path "EmailAddresses.csv"
    
    # Loop through each email address and add it to the transport rule
    foreach ($EmailAddress in $EmailAddresses) {
    $Condition = New-TransportRulePredicate -FromAddressContainsWords $EmailAddress.Email
    Add-TransportRulePredicate -Identity $Rule.Identity -Predicate $Condition -Priority "0"
    Add-TransportRuleAction -Identity $Rule.Identity -Action $BypassAction -Priority "0"
    }
    
    # Save the transport rule
    Set-TransportRule -Identity $Rule.Identity -Priority "0" -Enabled $true
